description: This file contains test cases for configuration environment variable management in a TypeScript project. It uses the 'vitest' testing framework to verify functions related to environment variable loading, substitution, and validation, specifically for the openclaw project.

methods.name: loadDotEnv
methods.description: Loads environment variables from a .env file, usually from a user's home directory or specified location.

methods.name: resolveConfigEnvVars
methods.description: Resolves environment variable substitutions within a configuration object, replacing placeholders with actual env values.

methods.name: applyConfigEnvVars
methods.description: Applies environment variables from a configuration object to process.env, respecting overrides and safety checks.

methods.name: collectConfigRuntimeEnvVars
methods.description: Collects environment variables from the configuration object for runtime application, filtering out unsafe or non-portable keys.

methods.name: createConfigRuntimeEnv
methods.description: Creates a merged runtime environment object based on configuration environment variables without mutating process.env.

methods.name: readStateDirDotEnvVars
methods.description: Reads key-value pairs from a .env file located in the state directory, used for persistent environment configuration.

methods.name: withEnvOverride
methods.description: Temporarily overrides environment variables within async test contexts to simulate different environment scenarios.

methods.name: withTempHome
methods.description: Creates a temporary home directory environment for testing environment variable loading from custom locations.

methods.name: writeStateDirDotEnv
methods.description: Writes key-value pairs to a .env file in the specified state directory, used for testing environment variable persistence.

ctags.name: first
ctags.pattern: /^        const first = resolveConfigEnvVars(config, process.env) as OpenClawConfig;$/

ctags.name: second
ctags.pattern: /^        const second = resolveConfigEnvVars(config, process.env) as OpenClawConfig;$/
